verdicts.explanation: The UHS LAGP total conductivity of 1.15×10-4 S/cm and Ea of 0.40±0.03 eV are stated in Section 3.3, with the 78% relative density and ~750 °C UHS temperature also given. The 180 s time is correctly converted to 0.05 h.
Conventional LAGP at 1.75×10-4 S/cm and 0.41±0.02 eV is reported as an experimental result, with 750 °C for 12 h and 80% relative density stated in Sections 2.1 and 2.2.

Section 3.4.1 gives LAGP-B conventional as ~1.70×10-4 S/cm with Ea 0.40±0.01 eV, and the ~78% density applies to the LAGP-B pellets. The 750 °C, 12 h conventional protocol applies to the additive mixtures per Section 2.1.
LAGP-B UHS at ~1.97×10-4 S/cm and Ea 0.36±0.02 eV (the UHS value in the sentence giving 0.40 vs 0.36 eV) matches the paper, which is experimental and at room temperature.

The LAGP-LBO conventional value of ~2.25×10-4 S/cm matches the paper. The 0.36 eV activation energy follows the conventional-then-UHS order used throughout. Density is correctly null. The 750 °C/12 h protocol is the one the paper applies to the additive mixtures, so it is supported despite the record's note saying it was set to null.
LAGP-LBO UHS at ~2.3×10-4 S/cm, Ea 0.33±0.03 eV, and ~75% relative density all match Sections 3.4.2 and the UHS sintering protocol.
The conventional LAGP grain-boundary conductivity of 9.79×10-6 S/cm from the brick-layer model is reported as this paper's own result at room temperature, with 80% density.
The UHS LAGP grain-boundary conductivity of 5.96×10-6 S/cm is stated in Section 3.3 as the paper's own brick-layer result at room temperature.
LAGP-B UHS grain-boundary conductivity of 1.15×10-5 S/cm is reported in Section 3.4.1 as this paper's brick-layer result at room temperature.
LAGP-LBO UHS grain-boundary conductivity of 3.06×10-5 S/cm (~5× LAGP UHS) is reported in Section 3.4.2 as this paper's result, with 75% density.
